name: kingshot-tools
description: Research Kingshot events, generate reproducible event-pack CP reports, query packs, calculate CP value, and match confirmed bilingual names.

interface.shortDescription: Research events, value packs, and match exact bilingual names.
interface.longDescription: Research Kingshot event rules, gameplay, milestones, schedules, and strategies; verify the player's current server progression, purchased packs, remaining resources, pack contents, and rewards; generate reproducible Markdown reports whose primary recommendations use marginal CP from the no-additional-purchase baseline; and match confirmed Traditional Chinese and English game identifiers with a conflict-safe persistent glossary.
defaultPrompt: 查詢 Kingshot 活動的玩法、計分、里程碑與時程。
先確認伺服器進度、已購禮包、剩餘資源與獎品內容，再以不加購基準為 Kingshot 活動產生邊際 CP 報告。
查詢 Kingshot 禮包的價格與內容。
計算這個 Kingshot 禮包的 CP 值。
查詢或確認 Kingshot 遊戲內中英文名稱配對，並安全記錄使用者已確認的新詞條。
